query:
UPDATE
                email_links
            SET
                is_sync_active = true,
                needs_reauth = false,
                sync_generation = $2,
                grant_generation = $3,
                last_sync_error_at = NULL,
                mailbox_issue = NULL,
                mailbox_retry_at = NULL,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE
                id = $1
